---
title: "Data control and societal governance"
subtitle: "Section 4"

Trace your data, compare feasible protections, and develop an evidence-backed political position.

## Learning goal

Evaluate data and authority in your workflow and distinguish personal safeguards from collective protections.

## Slides

- [Data control and societal governance](../slides/governance.qmd)

These decks are working teaching drafts. Slide text is available in the editable Quarto source.

## Main topics

- Data flows, ownership, access, retention, and portability
- Institutional services, hosted models, and local or rented infrastructure
- Societal evidence, uncertainty, counterarguments, and political agency

## Practice

Prepare a data-control review and a reflection grounded in evidence. The planned discussion includes responses to one or two peers; access, privacy, moderation, and assessment arrangements will be specified before use.

Exercise details are proposals for instructor review. The final rubric and submission arrangements will accompany the teaching release.
